Psalm 23:6 KJV
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

“Surely,” the passage said…not hopefully, not possibly, but, surely, certainly, goodness and mercy will follow you.

Goodness and mercy following you is not like those following you on Instagram and twitter.

To Follow means to “pursue, to chase, to seek after.

This week, Goodness and mercy will aggressively pursue you..

You can’t get away from the duo. They are like a “heat seeking missiles” and they cannot miss their target…you

Walk???? in the consciousness of it that goodness and mercy follows you daily..

?
You will see visible & tangible evidence today and in all your endeavors in Jesus name
